reasons: ⛔ DEFLATION — PBO over the ELIGIBLE set is 0.200 ≥ 0.2. ⭐ READ IT AS A **TIE**, NOT AS OVERFITTING: the contender spread is 0.394% and the in-sample halves split across arms a fraction of a percent apart (R2_eb_shrink_2k 81% (+0.000%), R1_eb_shrink 14% (+0.283%), R3_shrink_to_level 5% (+0.394%)). Which tied arm wins is noise — exactly what a trustworthy learner-null looks like (E2.1-r). The honest record is 'no candidate robustly beats the shipped configuration', so the shipped configuration is now PROVEN rather than assumed. Either way it does not ship.
